characterization_methods: Diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier transform spectroscopy (DRIFT)
evidence: Elemental analysis, infrared spectroscopy, and electron spin resonance spectroscopy were used. Diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier transform spectroscopy (DRIFT) was used. The specific surface areas were measured by the single-point BET method. The reaction products were analyzed on line with a Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) gas analyzer and a gas chromatograph (GC). Elemental analysis was done by dissolving samples in lithium tetraborate flux and diluted nitric acid. Carbon contents were determined by burning at 1350 ◦C in oxygen. The carbon and nitrogen contents were measured by burning at 950 ◦C in air. Electron spin resonance (ESR) spectroscopy was used. The reaction products were analyzed on line with a Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) gas analyzer and a gas chromatograph (GC).
